learning_outcomes.text: Students can analyze and calculate simple linear circuits using complex AC circuit analysis. The different types of power (active, reactive, and apparent power) are understood.

Students understand the basic physical principles of electrical machines and drives, can evaluate, select, and apply the various machine types in an industrial environment. The analysis of equivalent circuits and operating characteristics is also taught.

syllabus_topics: Electrical Engineering Fundamentals: Power, Work, Efficiency in Mechanics and Electrical Engineering
Linear one-ports R, L, and C
Special electrical machines: DC machine, three-phase asynchronous machine, synchronous machine
Introduction to modern drive technology and power converter technology

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in practical course (two experiments)

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination and proof of performance (active participation in the practical course).
